## About
Master Auto Parts & Paint Supply is a neighborhood parts and paint counter at 10949 Tuxford St in Sun Valley. People come here for parts, for paint supplies, and for an honest answer about what their project actually needs.
Customers tell us they like the easygoing atmosphere, fair prices and the help finding hard to get parts. We're rated 4.9 from 53 Google reviews, and a lot of those folks have been coming back for years.

## Services
- Auto parts: Parts for your car or project, with help at the counter finding the right one.
- Paint supply: Paint and supplies for your auto paint work, right alongside the parts counter.
- Individual sheets: Need just a few sheets instead of a whole box? We sell individual sheets of things like Trizact, so you only buy what the job calls for.

## FAQ
Q: What if you don't have the part I need?
A: Ask at the counter. Reviewers say if it isn't in stock, Rick can find it, and if you ask early enough in the day he can often get it the same day.

Q: What if I ask later in the day?
A: Customers say a part ordered later in the day usually shows up by the next morning.

Q: Can I ask a car question?
A: Yes. Send us your question through the contact form on our website, call us, or just ask when you come in.
